name: Abandoned Cart Items
query:
SELECT
  soi.item_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT so.name) AS "Carts:int:100",
  SUM(soi.amount) AS "Total Value:Currency:150"
FROM
  `tabSales Order Item` AS soi
JOIN
  `tabSales Order` AS so ON so.name = soi.parent
WHERE
  so.docstatus = 0 -- 0 = Draft
  
  -- Optional: Add this line to only show carts older than 1 hour
  -- AND so.creation < (NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
GROUP BY
  soi.item_code, soi.item_name
ORDER BY
  `Carts:int:100` DESC
LIMIT 5

name: Top Cities by Order Value
query:
SELECT
  a.city,
  COUNT(so.name) AS "Orders:int:100",
  SUM(so.grand_total) AS "Total Value:Currency:150"
FROM
  `tabSales Order` AS so
JOIN
  `tabAddress` AS a ON a.name = so.shipping_address_name -- Link to the Address DocType
WHERE
  so.docstatus = 1 -- 1 = Submitted (actual orders)
  AND a.city IS NOT NULL
  AND a.city != ''
GROUP BY
  a.city
ORDER BY
  "Orders:int:100" DESC
LIMIT 5

name: Sales Rep Performance
query:

    SUM(t1.grand_total) AS 'Total Sales Amount' -- Sales value ka total

    `tabSales Order` t1

GROUP BY
    t1.custom_customer_sales_representative
ORDER BY

name: Sales Person Customer Report
report_script:
columns = [
    {"label": "Sales Person", "fieldname": "sales_person", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 180},
    {"label": "Customer", "fieldname": "customer_name", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 180},
    {"label": "CV Price Level", "fieldname": "cv_price", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 150},
    {"label": "UDC Price Level", "fieldname": "udc_price", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 150},
    {"label": "Assigned Price Date (CV)", "fieldname": "cv_assigned_date", "fieldtype": "Datetime", "width": 180},
    {"label": "Assigned Price Date (UDC)", "fieldname": "udc_assigned_date", "fieldtype": "Datetime", "width": 180},
    {"label": "Last Change Date in Price Level", "fieldname": "last_change_date", "fieldtype": "Datetime", "width": 180},
]

data = []

customers = frappe.db.get_list(
    "Customer",
    fields=["name", "sales_person", "customer_name", "price_list_for_cv", "price_list_for_udc"]
)

for cust in customers:

    # get change logs from Version table
    versions = frappe.db.get_all(
        "Version",
        filters={"ref_doctype": "Customer", "docname": cust.name},
        fields=["data", "creation"],
        order_by="creation desc"
    )

    cv_assigned_date = None
    udc_assigned_date = None
    last_change_date = None

    for v in versions:
        try:
            changes = json.loads(v.data)
            if "changed" in changes:
                for change in changes["changed"]:
                    fieldname, old, new = change
                    if fieldname == "price_list_for_cv" and not cv_assigned_date:
                        cv_assigned_date = v.creation
                        last_change_date = v.creation
                    if fieldname == "price_list_for_udc" and not udc_assigned_date:
                        udc_assigned_date = v.creation
                        last_change_date = v.creation
        except Exception:
            pass

    data.append({
        "sales_person": cust.sales_person,
        "customer_name": cust.customer_name,
        "cv_price": cust.price_list_for_cv,
        "udc_price": cust.price_list_for_udc,
        "cv_assigned_date": cv_assigned_date,
        "udc_assigned_date": udc_assigned_date,
        "last_change_date": last_change_date,
    })

data = columns, data

name: Last Month Orders Summary CV
query:
SELECT
    company AS "Company:Link/Company:150",
    name AS "Sales Order:Link/Sales Order:150",
    transaction_date AS "Order Date:Date:120",
    customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:150",
    grand_total AS "Total Amount:Currency:120",
    status AS "Status::100"
FROM `tabSales Order`
WHERE
    docstatus = 1
    AND company = 'Cotton Valley'
    AND transaction_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m-01')
    AND transaction_date < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%%Y-%%m-01')
ORDER BY transaction_date DESC

name: Best Selling Products CV
query:
SELECT
    SO.company AS company,
    SOI.item_code AS item_code,
    SOI.item_name AS item_name,
    SUM(SOI.qty) AS total_quantity_sold,
    SUM(SOI.qty * SOI.base_rate) AS total_sales_value
FROM
    `tabSales Order Item` SOI
JOIN
    `tabSales Order` SO ON SOI.parent = SO.name
WHERE
    SO.docstatus = 1  -- Only consider submitted/confirmed orders
    AND SO.company = 'Cotton Valley'
GROUP BY
    SOI.item_code,
    SOI.item_name,
    SO.company
ORDER BY
    total_quantity_sold DESC, total_sales_value DESC
LIMIT 20;

name: Employee Device Registration
query:
SELECT
    p.employee AS "Employee:Link/Employee:120",
    p.employee_name AS "Employee Name:Data:180",
    COUNT(c.name) AS "Total Devices:Int:120"
FROM
    `tabEmployee Device Registration` p
LEFT JOIN
    `tabEmployee Devices` c ON c.parent = p.name
GROUP BY
    p.employee
ORDER BY
    COUNT(c.name) DESC
